Black.

The text explores the duality of human effort through the lens of reader perspective. For those who value process and resilience, the narrative serves as an inspiring testament to perseverance, highlighting the dignity found in the struggle itself. Conversely, for readers who prioritize tangible outcomes and success, the story may evoke a sense of tragedy, emphasizing the apparent futility of exertion when it does not yield a material reward. This contrast illustrates how personal values shape the interpretation of literary themes, allowing the same narrative to function as both a celebration of endurance and a meditation on loss.
